{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRCof88AAAABf-EAZg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn7ElzhJbDM0", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn7El", "number": 195, "title": "Default new browser sessions to Sharp CRT while preserving saved display preferences", "body": "## Problem

CRT presentation was implemented in #191, but **first-time visitors still get "LCD / Original pixels (off)"**. In [`web/index.html`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/web/index.html), `off` is the first option in the Display select and `sharp` is not selected by default. [`web/app.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/web/app.js) restores `pc98-presentation` from localStorage if present, then calls `Presenter.setPreset` with the select's current value. [`web/presenter.js`](https://github.com/takahirox/pc98-rust/blob/main/web/presenter.js) also initializes the presenter internally with `preset = 'off'`.

Thus users with **no previous saved preference** start in the unfiltered digital display, despite the intended era-appropriate PC-98 RGB CRT experience.

## Goal

Make **Sharp CRT** the default appearance on a fresh visit, while retaining the unfiltered LCD/Original pixels mode as an explicit user choice and as the safety fallback when WebGL2 is unavailable.

This is a **default-preference change**, not a new CRT shader implementation or a change in emulated video timing.

## Implementation

- [ ] On a fresh visit with no valid saved presentation settings, select `sharp` and enable the existing WebGL CRT presenter. Use the existing restrained Sharp CRT settings (4:3 display correction, subtle scanlines and horizontal softness). Keep the optional RGB phosphor mask **off** by default.
- [ ] Make initialization consistent between HTML defaults, `web/app.js` preference handling, and `Presenter` fallback/default behavior. Avoid a flash of the incorrect unfiltered mode before first presentation if practical.
- [ ] **Respect existing user preferences**: if localStorage contains a valid `off`, `sharp`, `soft`, or `strong` selection and mask choice, preserve it across reloads; especially do not forcibly override users who intentionally selected Original pixels. An absent, malformed or invalid setting should resolve predictably to Sharp CRT.
- [ ] Preserve instantaneous manual switching between LCD / Original pixels, Sharp CRT, Soft CRT and Strong CRT without restarting the guest. Preserve normal settings persistence when storage works, and graceful initialization when storage is blocked.
- [ ] Keep the current fallback to raw 2D output when WebGL2 initialization, shader compilation or rendering fails or the context is lost. The visible selector/status must not misleadingly claim CRT is being rendered when actual output is raw.
- [ ] Preserve PC-98 display legibility, keyboard/mouse focus and pointer coordinates, fullscreen/resizing behavior, 4:3 geometry, raw screenshots, frame buffer ownership and the existing emulator/render/audio Worker separation.
- [ ] Update relevant UI documentation and automated browser tests: fresh clean-storage sessions default to Sharp CRT at both serving roots; explicit saved `off` remains off; other saved presets are honored; invalid/corrupt storage falls back to sharp; WebGL fallback still displays a usable screen. Confirm no guest/audio timing or rendering throughput regression under representative normal playback.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New visitor (no saved setting): **Sharp CRT** is selected and visibly used when supported, with RGB mask disabled.
- [ ] Returning visitor: their stored choice, including intentionally selected **Original pixels**, remains unchanged.
- [ ] Unsupported or failed WebGL: the emulated screen remains visible in the original, unfiltered Canvas presentation.
- [ ] Existing browser/CRT-presentation and release-Wasm/audio acceptance, both `/` and `/pc98-rust/`, pass without introducing new CPU load, PCM gaps or altered guest pixels.

Related: #191 (CRT shader implementation), #146 and #172 (performance/audio capacity).
